items.headline: Tech Sector Rebounds as Microsoft Surges, Investors Weigh Economic Data
items.summary: U.S. stock indices are showing gains today, with the Nasdaq leading the charge, fueled by Microsoft's stronger-than-expected earnings report. This positive movement is helping to offset lingering concerns from the Federal Reserve's decision to keep interest rates steady and mixed economic data releases.

items.headline: Microsoft Rallies on Strong Cloud Performance
items.summary: Microsoft ($MSFT) shares surged nearly 9% today after the software giant's Azure cloud business exceeded Wall Street's expectations, topping $100 billion in annual revenue for the first time.

items.headline: Meta Platforms Drops on Missed Forecasts and AI Spending Concerns
items.summary: Meta Platforms ($META) shares fell 8.8% after the Facebook parent missed earnings forecasts and provided weaker-than-expected revenue guidance, with a reported 91% drop in second-quarter free cash flow highlighting the strain of its AI investments.

items.headline: Norwegian Cruise Line Down on Trimmed Full-Year Forecast
items.summary: Norwegian Cruise Line ($NCLH) experienced a decline of 7% today after the company announced a reduction in its full-year earnings forecast.

items.headline: Federal Reserve Holds Rates Steady Amid Dissent
items.summary: The Federal Reserve maintained its key interest rate in the 3.50%-3.75% range for the fifth consecutive meeting on Wednesday, though three officials dissented in favor of a rate hike. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh reiterated commitment to combating inflation but offered limited insight into future policy moves, leaving investors uncertain.

items.headline: U.S. Q2 GDP Growth Slows, Inflation Remains Elevated
items.summary: The U.S. economy expanded at a slower-than-expected annualized rate of 1.5% in the second quarter of 2026, falling short of the anticipated 2.1%. Concurrently, the Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index, the Fed's preferred inflation gauge, showed annual inflation at 3.7%, still above the central bank's 2% target, despite a monthly dip in June.

items.headline: Technology Sector Shows Mixed Signals; Health Care and Financials Gain Attention
items.summary: The technology sector is experiencing divergent trends; while cloud and AI-driven companies like Microsoft are performing strongly, the broader tech market, particularly semiconductors, faces ongoing liquidation. Analysts suggest a rotation into more defensive sectors such as Health Care and Financials.

items.headline: Apple and Amazon Earnings Anticipated After Bell
items.summary: Investors are keenly awaiting the quarterly earnings reports from major tech giants Apple ($AAPL) and Amazon ($AMZN), both scheduled to be released after the market closes today.
